title: Code review: `roguelike_engine` (~15.7k LOC, Bevy 0.17)
summary: Code review of the previous roguelike_engine crate, inventorying subsystems with extract/redesign/drop verdicts and diagnosing why the game reimplemented it instead of depending on it.
notes: Code review of a prior engine, cited by docs/PLAN.md as evidence. Contains per-subsystem verdicts (EXTRACT-AS-IS / WITH-REDESIGN / GAME-SIDE / DROP) that read like recommendations, but they are not accepted decisions or requirements; the locked decisions live in docs/PLAN.md. No frontmatter or filename convention, so confidence is medium. Output filename uses the 'unhashed' suffix matching sibling classifiers because no tool to compute SHA-256 was available.
